content.latin: 114:1 Diléxi, quóniam exáudiet Dóminus * vocem oratiónis meæ.
content.english: 114:1 I have loved, because the Lord will hear * the voice of my prayer.

segments.t: Diléxi, quóniam exáudiet Dóminus * vocem oratiónis meæ.

content.latin: 114:2 Quia inclinávit aurem suam mihi: * et in diébus meis invocábo.
content.english: 114:2 Because he hath inclined his ear unto me: * and in my days I will call upon him.

segments.t: Quia inclinávit aurem suam mihi: * et in diébus meis invocábo.

content.latin: 114:3 Circumdedérunt me dolóres mortis: * et perícula inférni invenérunt me.
content.english: 114:3 The sorrows of death have compassed me: * and the perils of hell have found me.

segments.t: Circumdedérunt me dolóres mortis: * et perícula inférni invenérunt me.

content.latin: 114:3 Tribulatiónem et dolórem invéni: * et nomen Dómini invocávi.
content.english: 114:3 I met with trouble and sorrow: * and I called upon the name of the Lord.

segments.t: Tribulatiónem et dolórem invéni: * et nomen Dómini invocávi.

content.latin: 114:4 O Dómine, líbera ánimam meam: * miséricors Dóminus, et iustus, et Deus noster miserétur.
content.english: 114:4 O Lord, deliver my soul. * The Lord is merciful and just, and our God sheweth mercy.

segments.t: O Dómine, líbera ánimam meam: * miséricors Dóminus, et iustus, et Deus noster miserétur.

content.latin: 114:6 Custódiens párvulos Dóminus: * humiliátus sum, et liberávit me.
content.english: 114:6 The Lord is the keeper of little ones: * I was humbled, and he delivered me.

segments.t: Custódiens párvulos Dóminus: * humiliátus sum, et liberávit me.

content.latin: 114:7 Convértere, ánima mea, in réquiem tuam: * quia Dóminus benefécit tibi.
content.english: 114:7 Turn, O my soul, into thy rest: * for the Lord hath been bountiful to thee.

segments.t: Convértere, ánima mea, in réquiem tuam: * quia Dóminus benefécit tibi.

content.latin: 114:8 Quia erípuit ánimam meam de morte: * óculos meos a lácrimis, pedes meos a lapsu.
content.english: 114:8 For he hath delivered my soul from death: * my eyes from tears, my feet from falling.

segments.t: Quia erípuit ánimam meam de morte: * óculos meos a lácrimis, pedes meos a lapsu.

content.latin: 114:9 Placébo Dómino * in regióne vivórum.

content.latin: 119:1 Ad Dóminum cum tribulárer clamávi: * et exaudívit me.
content.english: 119:1 In my trouble I cried to the Lord: * and he heard me.

segments.t: Ad Dóminum cum tribulárer clamávi: * et exaudívit me.

content.latin: 119:2 Dómine, líbera ánimam meam a lábiis iníquis, * et a lingua dolósa.
content.english: 119:2 O Lord, deliver my soul from wicked lips, * and a deceitful tongue.

segments.t: Dómine, líbera ánimam meam a lábiis iníquis, * et a lingua dolósa.

content.latin: 119:3 Quid detur tibi, aut quid apponátur tibi * ad linguam dolósam?
content.english: 119:3 What shall be given to thee, or what shall be added to thee, * to a deceitful tongue?

segments.t: Quid detur tibi, aut quid apponátur tibi * ad linguam dolósam?

content.latin: 119:4 Sagíttæ poténtis acútæ, * cum carbónibus desolatóriis.
content.english: 119:4 The sharp arrows of the mighty, * with coals that lay waste.

segments.t: Sagíttæ poténtis acútæ, * cum carbónibus desolatóriis.

content.latin: 119:5 Heu mihi, quia incolátus meus prolongátus est: habitávi cum habitántibus Cedar: * multum íncola fuit ánima mea.
content.english: 119:5 Woe is me, that my sojourning is prolonged! I have dwelt with the inhabitants of Cedar: * my soul hath been long a sojourner.

segments.t: Heu mihi, quia incolátus meus prolongátus est: habitávi cum habitántibus Cedar: * multum íncola fuit ánima mea.

content.latin: 119:7 Cum his, qui odérunt pacem, eram pacíficus: * cum loquébar illis, impugnábant me gratis.
content.english: 119:7 With them that hated peace I was peaceable: * when I spoke to them they fought against me without cause.

segments.t: Cum his, qui odérunt pacem, eram pacíficus: * cum loquébar illis, impugnábant me gratis.

content.latin: 120:1 Levávi óculos meos in montes, * unde véniet auxílium mihi.
content.english: 120:1 I have lifted up my eyes to the mountains, * from whence help shall come to me.

segments.t: Levávi óculos meos in montes, * unde véniet auxílium mihi.

content.latin: 120:2 Auxílium meum a Dómino, * qui fecit cælum et terram.
content.english: 120:2 My help is from the Lord, * who made heaven and earth.

segments.t: Auxílium meum a Dómino, * qui fecit cælum et terram.

content.latin: 120:3 Non det in commotiónem pedem tuum: * neque dormítet qui custódit te.
content.english: 120:3 May he not suffer thy foot to be moved: * neither let him slumber that keepeth thee.

segments.t: Non det in commotiónem pedem tuum: * neque dormítet qui custódit te.

content.latin: 120:4 Ecce, non dormitábit neque dórmiet, * qui custódit Israël.
content.english: 120:4 Behold he shall neither slumber nor sleep, * that keepeth Israel.

segments.t: Ecce, non dormitábit neque dórmiet, * qui custódit Israël.

content.latin: 120:5 Dóminus custódit te, Dóminus protéctio tua, * super manum déxteram tuam.
content.english: 120:5 The Lord is thy keeper, the Lord is thy protection * upon thy right hand.

segments.t: Dóminus custódit te, Dóminus protéctio tua, * super manum déxteram tuam.

content.latin: 120:6 Per diem sol non uret te: * neque luna per noctem.
content.english: 120:6 The sun shall not burn thee by day: * nor the moon by night.

segments.t: Per diem sol non uret te: * neque luna per noctem.

content.latin: 120:7 Dóminus custódit te ab omni malo: * custódiat ánimam tuam Dóminus.
content.english: 120:7 The Lord keepeth thee from all evil: * may the Lord keep thy soul.

segments.t: Dóminus custódit te ab omni malo: * custódiat ánimam tuam Dóminus.

content.latin: 120:8 Dóminus custódiat intróitum tuum, et éxitum tuum: * ex hoc nunc, et usque in sǽculum.
content.english: 120:8 May the Lord keep thy coming in and thy going out; * from henceforth now and for ever.

segments.t: Dóminus custódiat intróitum tuum, et éxitum tuum: * ex hoc nunc, et usque in sǽculum.

content.latin: 129:1 De profúndis clamávi ad te, Dómine: * Dómine, exáudi vocem meam:
content.english: 129:1 Out of the depths I have cried to thee, O Lord: * Lord, hear my voice.

segments.t: De profúndis clamávi ad te, Dómine: * Dómine, exáudi vocem meam:

content.latin: 129:2 Fiant aures tuæ intendéntes, * in vocem deprecatiónis meæ.
content.english: 129:2 Let thy ears be attentive * to the voice of my supplication.

segments.t: Fiant aures tuæ intendéntes, * in vocem deprecatiónis meæ.

content.latin: 129:3 Si iniquitátes observáveris, Dómine: * Dómine, quis sustinébit?
content.english: 129:3 If thou, O Lord, wilt mark iniquities: * Lord, who shall stand it.

segments.t: Si iniquitátes observáveris, Dómine: * Dómine, quis sustinébit?

content.latin: 129:4 Quia apud te propitiátio est: * et propter legem tuam sustínui te, Dómine.
content.english: 129:4 For with thee there is merciful forgiveness: * and by reason of thy law, I have waited for thee, O Lord.

segments.t: Quia apud te propitiátio est: * et propter legem tuam sustínui te, Dómine.

content.latin: 129:5 Sustínuit ánima mea in verbo eius: * sperávit ánima mea in Dómino.
content.english: 129:5 My soul hath relied on his word: * my soul hath hoped in the Lord.

segments.t: Sustínuit ánima mea in verbo eius: * sperávit ánima mea in Dómino.

content.latin: 129:6 A custódia matutína usque ad noctem: * speret Israël in Dómino.
content.english: 129:6 From the morning watch even until night, * let Israel hope in the Lord.

segments.t: A custódia matutína usque ad noctem: * speret Israël in Dómino.

content.latin: 129:7 Quia apud Dóminum misericórdia: * et copiósa apud eum redémptio.
content.english: 129:7 Because with the Lord there is mercy: * and with him plentiful redemption.

segments.t: Quia apud Dóminum misericórdia: * et copiósa apud eum redémptio.

content.latin: 129:8 Et ipse rédimet Israël, * ex ómnibus iniquitátibus eius.
content.english: 129:8 And he shall redeem Israel * from all his iniquities.

segments.t: Et ipse rédimet Israël, * ex ómnibus iniquitátibus eius.

content.english: Psalm 137 [5]

segments.t: Psalmus 137

content.latin: 137:1 Confitébor tibi, Dómine, in toto corde meo: * quóniam audísti verba oris mei.
content.english: 137:1 I will praise thee, O Lord, with my whole heart: * for thou hast heard the words of my mouth.

segments.t: Confitébor tibi, Dómine, in toto corde meo: * quóniam audísti verba oris mei.

content.latin: 137:2 In conspéctu Angelórum psallam tibi: * adorábo ad templum sanctum tuum, et confitébor nómini tuo.
content.english: 137:2 I will sing praise to thee in the sight of the Angels: * I will worship towards thy holy temple, and I will give glory to thy name.

segments.t: In conspéctu Angelórum psallam tibi: * adorábo ad templum sanctum tuum, et confitébor nómini tuo.

content.latin: 137:3 Super misericórdia tua, et veritáte tua: * quóniam magnificásti super omne, nomen sanctum tuum.
content.english: 137:3 For thy mercy, and for thy truth: * for thou hast magnified thy holy name

segments.t: Super misericórdia tua, et veritáte tua: * quóniam magnificásti super omne, nomen sanctum tuum.

content.latin: 137:4 In quacúmque die invocávero te, exáudi me: * multiplicábis in ánima mea virtútem.
content.english: 137:4 In what day soever I shall call upon thee, hear me: * thou shalt multiply strength in my soul.

segments.t: In quacúmque die invocávero te, exáudi me: * multiplicábis in ánima mea virtútem.

content.latin: 137:5 Confiteántur tibi, Dómine, omnes reges terræ: * quia audiérunt ómnia verba oris tui:
content.english: 137:5 May all the kings of the earth give glory to thee: * for they have heard all the words of thy mouth.

segments.t: Confiteántur tibi, Dómine, omnes reges terræ: * quia audiérunt ómnia verba oris tui:

content.latin: 137:6 Et cantent in viis Dómini: * quóniam magna est glória Dómini.
content.english: 137:6 And let them sing in the ways of the Lord: * for great is the glory of the Lord.

segments.t: Et cantent in viis Dómini: * quóniam magna est glória Dómini.

content.latin: 137:7 Quóniam excélsus Dóminus, et humília réspicit: * et alta a longe cognóscit.
content.english: 137:7 For the Lord is high, and looketh on the low: * and the high he knoweth afar off.

segments.t: Quóniam excélsus Dóminus, et humília réspicit: * et alta a longe cognóscit.

content.latin: 137:8 Si ambulávero in médio tribulatiónis, vivificábis me: * et super iram inimicórum meórum extendísti manum tuam, et salvum me fecit déxtera tua.
content.english: 137:8 If I shall walk in the midst of tribulation, thou wilt quicken me: * and thou hast stretched forth thy hand against the wrath of my enemies: and thy right hand hath saved me.

segments.t: Si ambulávero in médio tribulatiónis, vivificábis me: * et super iram inimicórum meórum extendísti manum tuam, et salvum me fecit déxtera tua.

content.latin: 137:9 Dóminus retríbuet pro me: * Dómine, misericórdia tua in sǽculum: ópera mánuum tuárum ne despícias.
content.english: 137:9 The Lord will repay for me: * thy mercy, O Lord, endureth for ever: O despise not the works of thy hands.

segments.t: Dóminus retríbuet pro me: * Dómine, misericórdia tua in sǽculum: ópera mánuum tuárum ne despícias.

segments.t: Audívi vocem de cælo dicéntem mihi.

content.english: 1:46 My soul ✠ * doth magnify the Lord.

segments.t: Magníficat ✠ * ánima mea Dóminum.

content.latin: 1:47 Et exsultávit spíritus meus: * in Deo, salutári meo.
content.english: 1:47 And my spirit hath rejoiced * in God my Saviour.

segments.t: Et exsultávit spíritus meus: * in Deo, salutári meo.

content.latin: 1:48 Quia respéxit humilitátem ancíllæ suæ: * ecce enim ex hoc beátam me dicent omnes generatiónes.
content.english: 1:48 Because he hath regarded the humility of his handmaid; * for behold from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

segments.t: Quia respéxit humilitátem ancíllæ suæ: * ecce enim ex hoc beátam me dicent omnes generatiónes.

content.latin: 1:49 Quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est: * et sanctum nomen eius.
content.english: 1:49 Because he that is mighty, hath done great things to me; * and holy is his name.

segments.t: Quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est: * et sanctum nomen eius.

content.latin: 1:50 Et misericórdia eius, a progénie in progénies: * timéntibus eum.
content.english: 1:50 And his mercy is from generation unto generations, * to them that fear him.

segments.t: Et misericórdia eius, a progénie in progénies: * timéntibus eum.

content.latin: 1:51 Fecit poténtiam in brácchio suo: * dispérsit supérbos mente cordis sui.
content.english: 1:51 He hath shewed might in his arm: * he hath scattered the proud in the conceit of their heart.

segments.t: Fecit poténtiam in brácchio suo: * dispérsit supérbos mente cordis sui.

content.latin: 1:52 Depósuit poténtes de sede: * et exaltávit húmiles.
content.english: 1:52 He hath put down the mighty from their seat, * and hath exalted the humble.

segments.t: Depósuit poténtes de sede: * et exaltávit húmiles.

content.latin: 1:53 Esuriéntes implévit bonis: * et dívites dimísit inánes.

Ídeo precor beátam Maríam semper Vírginem, beátum Michaélem Archángelum, beátum Ioánnem Baptístam, sanctos Apóstolos Petrum et Paulum, et omnes Sanctos, oráre pro me ad Dóminum Deum nostrum.
content.english: I confess to almighty God, to blessed Mary ever Virgin, to blessed Michael the Archangel, to blessed John the Baptist, to the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, and to all the Saints, that I have sinned exceedingly in thought, word and deed: strikes his breast through my fault, through my fault, through my most grievous fault. content.latin: 141:2 Voce mea ad Dóminum clamávi: * voce mea ad Dóminum deprecátus sum:

segments.t: Voce mea ad Dóminum clamávi: * voce mea ad Dóminum deprecátus sum:

content.latin: 141:3 Effúndo in conspéctu eius oratiónem meam, * et tribulatiónem meam ante ipsum pronúntio.

segments.t: Effúndo in conspéctu eius oratiónem meam, * et tribulatiónem meam ante ipsum pronúntio.

content.latin: 141:4 In deficiéndo ex me spíritum meum, * et tu cognovísti sémitas meas.
content.english: 141:4 When my spirit failed me, * then thou knewest my paths.

segments.t: In deficiéndo ex me spíritum meum, * et tu cognovísti sémitas meas.

content.latin: 141:4 In via hac, qua ambulábam, * abscondérunt láqueum mihi.
content.english: 141:4 In this way wherein I walked, * they have hidden a snare for me.

segments.t: In via hac, qua ambulábam, * abscondérunt láqueum mihi.

content.latin: 141:5 Considerábam ad déxteram, et vidébam: * et non erat qui cognósceret me.
content.english: 141:5 I looked on my right hand, and beheld, * and there was no one that would know me.

segments.t: Considerábam ad déxteram, et vidébam: * et non erat qui cognósceret me.

content.latin: 141:5 Périit fuga a me, * et non est qui requírat ánimam meam.
content.english: 141:5 Flight hath failed me: * and there is no one that hath regard to my soul.

segments.t: Périit fuga a me, * et non est qui requírat ánimam meam.

content.latin: 141:6 Clamávi ad te, Dómine, * dixi: Tu es spes mea, pórtio mea in terra vivéntium.
content.english: 141:6 I cried to thee, O Lord: * I said: Thou art my hope, my portion in the land of the living.

segments.t: Clamávi ad te, Dómine, * dixi: Tu es spes mea, pórtio mea in terra vivéntium.

content.latin: 141:7 Inténde ad deprecatiónem meam: * quia humiliátus sum nimis.
content.english: 141:7 Attend to my supplication: * for I am brought very low.

segments.t: Inténde ad deprecatiónem meam: * quia humiliátus sum nimis.

content.latin: 141:7 Líbera me a persequéntibus me: * quia confortáti sunt super me.
content.english: 141:7 Deliver me from my persecutors; * for they are stronger than I.

segments.t: Líbera me a persequéntibus me: * quia confortáti sunt super me.

content.latin: 141:8 Educ de custódia ánimam meam ad confiténdum nómini tuo: * me exspéctant iusti, donec retríbuas mihi.

content.latin: 142:1 Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam: áuribus pércipe obsecratiónem meam in veritáte tua: * exáudi me in tua iustítia.
content.english: 142:1 Hear, O Lord, my prayer: give ear to my supplication in thy truth: * hear me in thy justice.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam: áuribus pércipe obsecratiónem meam in veritáte tua: * exáudi me in tua iustítia.

content.latin: 142:2 Et non intres in iudícium cum servo tuo: * quia non iustificábitur in conspéctu tuo omnis vivens.
content.english: 142:2 And enter not into judgment with thy servant: * for in thy sight no man living shall be justified.

segments.t: Et non intres in iudícium cum servo tuo: * quia non iustificábitur in conspéctu tuo omnis vivens.

content.latin: 142:3 Quia persecútus est inimícus ánimam meam: * humiliávit in terra vitam meam.
content.english: 142:3 For the enemy hath persecuted my soul: * he hath brought down my life to the earth.

segments.t: Quia persecútus est inimícus ánimam meam: * humiliávit in terra vitam meam.

content.latin: 142:3 Collocávit me in obscúris sicut mórtuos sǽculi: * et anxiátus est super me spíritus meus, in me turbátum est cor meum.
content.english: 142:3 He hath made me to dwell in darkness as those that have been dead of old: * and my spirit is in anguish within me: my heart within me is troubled.

segments.t: Collocávit me in obscúris sicut mórtuos sǽculi: * et anxiátus est super me spíritus meus, in me turbátum est cor meum.

content.latin: 142:5 Memor fui diérum antiquórum, meditátus sum in ómnibus opéribus tuis: * in factis mánuum tuárum meditábar.
content.english: 142:5 I remembered the days of old, I meditated on all thy works: * I meditated upon the works of thy hands.

segments.t: Memor fui diérum antiquórum, meditátus sum in ómnibus opéribus tuis: * in factis mánuum tuárum meditábar.

content.latin: 142:6 Expándi manus meas ad te: * ánima mea sicut terra sine aqua tibi.
content.english: 142:6 I stretched forth my hands to thee: * my soul is as earth without water unto thee.

segments.t: Expándi manus meas ad te: * ánima mea sicut terra sine aqua tibi.

content.latin: 142:7 Velóciter exáudi me, Dómine: * defécit spíritus meus.
content.english: 142:7 Hear me speedily, O Lord: * my spirit hath fainted away.

segments.t: Velóciter exáudi me, Dómine: * defécit spíritus meus.

content.latin: 142:7 Non avértas fáciem tuam a me: * et símilis ero descendéntibus in lacum.
content.english: 142:7 Turn not away thy face from me, * lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.

segments.t: Non avértas fáciem tuam a me: * et símilis ero descendéntibus in lacum.

content.latin: 142:8 Audítam fac mihi mane misericórdiam tuam: * quia in te sperávi.
content.english: 142:8 Cause me to hear thy mercy in the morning; * for in thee have I hoped.

segments.t: Audítam fac mihi mane misericórdiam tuam: * quia in te sperávi.

content.latin: 142:8 Notam fac mihi viam, in qua ámbulem: * quia ad te levávi ánimam meam.
content.english: 142:8 Make the way known to me, wherein I should walk: * for I have lifted up my soul to thee.

segments.t: Notam fac mihi viam, in qua ámbulem: * quia ad te levávi ánimam meam.

content.latin: 142:9 Éripe me de inimícis meis, Dómine, ad te confúgi: * doce me fácere voluntátem tuam, quia Deus meus es tu.
content.english: 142:9 Deliver me from my enemies, O Lord, to thee have I fled: * teach me to do thy will, for thou art my God.

segments.t: Éripe me de inimícis meis, Dómine, ad te confúgi: * doce me fácere voluntátem tuam, quia Deus meus es tu.

content.latin: 142:10 Spíritus tuus bonus dedúcet me in terram rectam: * propter nomen tuum, Dómine, vivificábis me, in æquitáte tua.
content.english: 142:10 Thy good spirit shall lead me into the right land: * for thy name’s sake, O Lord, thou wilt quicken me in thy justice.

segments.t: Spíritus tuus bonus dedúcet me in terram rectam: * propter nomen tuum, Dómine, vivificábis me, in æquitáte tua.

content.latin: 142:11 Edúces de tribulatióne ánimam meam: * et in misericórdia tua dispérdes inimícos meos.
content.english: 142:11 Thou wilt bring my soul out of trouble: * and in thy mercy thou wilt destroy my enemies.

segments.t: Edúces de tribulatióne ánimam meam: * et in misericórdia tua dispérdes inimícos meos.

content.latin: 142:12 Et perdes omnes, qui tríbulant ánimam meam: * quóniam ego servus tuus sum.
